topics.name: MetaModule Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for MetaModule definitions, composition closure, dependency bindings, nanoCMS placements and runtime activation state.

semantics.identity_rule: MetaModule definition, constituent, placement, route and runtime activation identities remain distinct.
semantics.ownership_rule: UI exposes which owner retains each constituent semantic responsibility.
semantics.action_rule: edit/place/remove-placement/activate/reload/deactivate operations invoke separate authorized canonical workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing MetaModule topology grants no constituent or lifecycle authority.
semantics.graph_rule: Visual composition/dependency/placement edges correspond only to explicit relations.
semantics.failure_rule: Missing dependencies, ownership conflicts and activation errors are shown explicitly.

invariants.rule: A MetaModule is an explicit composition of existing semantic capabilities; composition, placement or runtime activation never silently transfers ownership, identity or authority from constituent modules/resources.

hard_gates.condition: monitor conflates placement and MetaModule identity
monitor directly activates without explicit operation
inactive placement shown as active capability
